claim.reason: East elevation external double door ED1. Green dimension chain attached to the door head/bottom extension lines reads 1900 above / 2400 door / 200 below within the 4500 total wall height. Measured calibration: building top line profile_004 C01 at y=229, ground line profile_004 C02 at y=654 (425 px = 4500 mm). The 200 mm is the drawn plinth/step below the door frame; the door frame is genuinely drawn above the ground line. World z is absolute height above floor level 0.
